landmarks.paris-gorbeau-quarter-gateway: The hospital-quarter interior road west of the Salpêtrière, south of the Jardin des Plantes; opens the closer source-based boulevard reconstruction.
landmarks.paris-halles-gateway: The market blocks just southeast of Saint-Eustache; a district-scale gateway, not the Corinthe building.
landmarks.paris-marais: The dense right-bank quarter northeast of the central islands.
landmarks.paris-latin-quarter: The left-bank blocks between the Luxembourg and the river.
landmarks.luxembourg-gardens: Inside the formal garden south of its palace, rather than on a surrounding street.
landmarks.champs-elysees: The tree-lined western promenade above the river bend.
landmarks.boulevard-du-temple: The curving boulevard along the northeastern edge of the dense old city.
landmarks.paris-town-hall: The municipal-building footprint on the right bank beside its riverside square.
landmarks.faubourg-saint-antoine: The district east of the Bastille open place.
landmarks.paris-mouffetard-quarter: The southern neighborhood west of the Jardin des Plantes, represented at district scale.
landmarks.saint-sulpice: The church block west of the Luxembourg gardens.
landmarks.seine-paris: The broad watercourse beside the Jardin des Plantes and Salpêtrière; a general river setting, not a claimed exact incident site.
